title: EB-I20R1 cross-ledger provenance independent qualification
technical_finding: EB-I20R1 binds a prepared handle to generation, lineage, origin revision and interval, but not to a unique ledger instance. Two independent energy_trial_ledger_t instances can legitimately carry the same transaction provenance and local generation. A prepared handle copied from one such ledger is therefore accepted by the other for abort_prepared and commit_prepared, allowing one worker/ledger instance to consume or publish another instance's prepared energy state.
invariant_impact: Invariant 5 scratch per worker: worker-local transactional scratch is not cryptographically or structurally bound to its owning ledger instance.
Invariant 7 transactional time steps: a foreign prepared handle can mutate another ledger when provenance tuples alias.
Invariant 16 MultiSWAP primary use case: distinct columns/workers cannot rely on tuple uniqueness for isolation.
Invariant 29 no silent dependencies: correctness would otherwise depend on an undocumented global uniqueness assumption for lineage/revision/interval tuples.
hard_nonclaims: F-VQ82 does not canonically admit EB-I20R1.
The successful workflow means the independent attack executed successfully; it is a negative qualification result.
F-VQ82 does not invalidate the energy conservation algebra itself.
F-VQ82 does not modify production or reference source.
next_owner: EB-I20R2 minimal remediation with explicit ledger-instance-bound prepared-handle identity, followed by fresh independent qualification
